body:
## What's Changed
* adding back new features to docs by @mgbukov in https://github.com/QuSpin/QuSpin/pull/709
* Rename New_Features.html to new_features.html by @mgbukov in https://github.com/QuSpin/QuSpin/pull/710
* Fixing Version by @weinbe58 in https://github.com/QuSpin/QuSpin/pull/721

name: 0.2.0 Release!
body:
Some of the things we have added (see doc for more details):

1) New basis types:
   * spin_basis_1d now supports higher spins!
   * boson_basis_1d: basis object which supports bosonic matrix elements with symmetries.
   * fermion_basis_1d: basis object which supports fermionic (spinless) matrix elements with symmetries. 

2) all basis objects are supported by ent_entropy function, But there is a separate implementation of ent_entropy build into the basis classes themselves.

3) Evolution of density matrices with H.evolve, ED_state_vs_time and obs_vs_time. 

4) get_proj supports projection out of symmetry sector to the sector of particle conservation (if that applies for a given basis)
